verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a government online company-incorporation service, not an agent. Publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability for such a service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only web-form incorporation, authentication methods, payment and email notifications, with no MCP server, API or agent-connectivity of any kind.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
